title: Menstrual Cycle Characteristics of Healthcare Professionals
brief_summary: The Covid-19 pandemic has impacted healthcare workers physically and psychologically. The aim of this study is to examine whether there is a change in menstrual cycle characteristics during pandemia. The aim of this study is to investigate whether there is an association between covid infection and menstrual cycle changes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Working at Covid 19 Pandemic Hospital
* Being at between 18 and 47 years old
* Having menstruation

Exclusion Criteria:

* Oral contraceptive users
* Pregnants
* Having malignancy
* Having primary amenorrhea
* Being at menopause
* Lactation
study_population: Healthy female healthcare workers at Covid 19 pandemic hospital
